title: RetrievalEvalRun
description: One execution of the retrieval-eval suite for a route under test against a pinned gold-set version. Mirrors safety_suite_runs (ADR-0004); persisted to the retrieval_eval_runs table. The second of two binding gates for purpose IN ('embedding','rerank') route certification.

routeId.description: The route under test (model_routes.route_id). For embedding routes this is the candidate; for rerank routes, the reranker.

purpose.description: Which certification path this run gates.

configLabel.description: Retrieval configuration exercised (ADR-0011/0012). One run per (route, config).

caseCount.description: Number of gold-set cases scored in this run.

scores.description: Metric name (e.g. recall_at_6, precision_at_6, mrr, ndcg_at_6, and any judge metrics) -> score in [0,1].

passed.description: Whether every baseline metric held within epsilon (or this was the first run for the version).

isFirstRun.description: True when no baseline existed for the gold-set version at run time.

judgeApplied.description: Whether the (paid) LLM-judge answer-quality metrics ran. False in the default offline CI path.

regressions.description: Metrics that dropped beyond epsilon vs. the baseline; null/empty when passed.

initiatedBy.description: User id that initiated the run.
